style: Clean flat vector illustration for a beginner guitar manual, thin dark navy outlines, a few flat fills (warm brass, off-white, navy), no text, no labels, no numbers, plain white background, generous margins, centered subject.

figures.parts: A full-length acoustic dreadnought guitar seen from the front, slightly tilted, every part visible: headstock with six tuning machines, nut, frets along the neck, soundhole, bridge, six strings.
figures.sit: A person sitting on the edge of a chair playing an acoustic guitar, correct posture: back straight, both feet flat on the floor, guitar body resting on the right thigh, neck rising slightly to the left, right forearm resting on the edge of the guitar body. Seen from the front, three-quarter view.
figures.left: Close-up of a left hand fretting chords on an acoustic guitar neck, seen from the player's side: thumb behind the neck roughly opposite the middle finger, fingers arched, pressing the strings with the fingertips just behind the metal frets, wrist relaxed and straight.
figures.pick: Close-up of a right hand holding a guitar pick between the pad of the thumb and the side of the index finger, only a few millimetres of the pick tip showing, other fingers relaxed and slightly curled, above the soundhole of an acoustic guitar.
